# PhysxVehicleDriveBasicAPI

Basic vehicle drive (a torque applied directly to the driven wheels) on the vehicle [prim](glossary.md#prim) or on a separate prim that physxVehicle:drive targets. Outside the drive parse the runtime only checks whether the vehicle prim itself lists it, to take the vehicle prim as the drive when physxVehicle:drive has no target.

- **Applies to:** [`Typed`](glossary.md#typed)
- **Read only when listed in [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns).**
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## Interactions

- **[`PhysxVehicleAPI`](PhysxVehicleAPI.md):** Listing both PhysxVehicleDriveBasicAPI and PhysxVehicleDriveStandardAPI on a vehicle prim without a physxVehicle:drive target logs an error and the vehicle is not created.
- **[`PhysxVehicleDriveStandardAPI`](PhysxVehicleDriveStandardAPI.md):** A physxVehicle:drive target is looked up as a standard drive first, then as a basic drive.

## Notes

- The drive parse reads physxVehicleDriveBasic:peakTorque and the runtime applies its live changes; it is not described yet.
